items.text: no grey frame before the black opening: the page is black from its very first paint
the opening comes in order, in about three seconds: the duck-rabbit, then the namemark and CURRENT as the frost reveals the field, then the paths and founders call, then the bottom row

Current opens on black with the white duck-rabbit and stays black until everything has loaded and the field is drawing; then the duck glides into place and the black clears to the frosted cover over the moving field. No flash before the cover
when the self-test finds a problem, a glitching ASCII duck-rabbit congratulates you: you found a bad thing, help us fix it. The report button is right there
no flash of the open index before the cover: the stage is there from the first moment
the field plays again for anyone with saved bytebeat formulas (the founding pack gives ten). The formula list was drawn before the sound engine existed, which stopped Current from starting

a self-test on load: Current checks the field is playing, and its presets, G-code, index, settings, paths and sound. If something is down, a message says so by itself, with reload and a report to send
the founders count shows once 20 have joined; until then the club invites you to be one of the first 100
